responses.action_taken: Fixed by removing the one-frame await from AudioBank._ready(). The method now creates MusicPlayer, VoicePlayer, and all SFX pool players synchronously before any external code (like LauncherOverlay._start_music()) can call them. The players are assigned to their respective buses (Music, Voice, SFX) immediately.

additional_changes.description: Implemented reduce-motion accessibility support across camera shakes and particle effects

acceptance_criteria.audio_buses_levels_and_blocking_cues_che: PASS - AudioBank now initializes synchronously, preventing the Nil assignment error. Music, Voice, and SFX buses are properly configured and players are assigned to correct buses.

summary: Approved with changes. The audio race condition has been fixed by making AudioBank._ready() synchronous. Additionally, reduce-motion accessibility support has been fully implemented across all motion-heavy systems (camera shakes and particle effects).
